item.title: Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the `orders` crate so an order's status is a proper type instead of a `String` compared against string literals. Operator's request:

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type implementing `std::error::Error` whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same. Before changing anything, characterize the current behaviour of parsing, errors, and report output, and confirm it is identical afterwards. `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work on the local branch (ship local; never push). Add no git identity overrides and no attribution lines.

state.summary:
Replaced the orders crate's String status with an OrderStatus enum. Branch archon/t44kkp2m-refactor-orders-status-string-into-order now has two commits on base 72861c5: 94d6872 adds tests/characterization.rs (13 tests pinning parsing, error text, transitions, status_counts ordering and CSV output; they passed on the untouched base first), and 9c6a37c adds src/status.rs (OrderStatus with as_str, Display via f.pad, FromStr, can_transition_to; public ParseStatusError), switches billing, shipping, order and report to the enum, and re-exports both types from the crate root. status_counts now returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)> still sorted by status name. The from_line error text is unchanged. Only src/status.rs contains the status literals. Checks on head 9c6a37c (tree 3295142a): cargo fmt --check OK; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean; cargo test 22 passed (characterization 13, orders 3, status 3, doc 0 plus lib 0). Base was not rustfmt-clean, so cargo fmt also reflowed existing lines in tests/orders.rs and the touched src files; whitespace only. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M7WFBDB542H9YXQNMW84JJGT) read base 72861c5 to head 9c6a37c and returned pass with no blocking findings. Non-blocking follow-ups: status_counts could collect-then-sort more simply; the public Order::status type change is the requested API break for external callers. Nothing pushed; no servers or processes were started.

pr.body: Approach: add src/status.rs (OrderStatus, ParseStatusError, as_str, Display, FromStr, can_transition_to). Switch billing.rs, shipping.rs, order.rs and report.rs to the enum; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from lib.rs. status_counts sorts by status name via a BTreeMap keyed by as_str. from_line keeps its 'unknown status' message. Characterization tests were committed first (94d6872) and pass unchanged after the refactor. Checks on 9c6a37c: fmt OK, clippy -D warnings clean, cargo test 22 passed. Assumption: Order::status becoming OrderStatus is the requested public API break; external callers must update.
pr.summary: Order status is now a typed enum with a lifecycle check. Before: status was a String compared against literals in four files. Now: OrderStatus enforces transitions via can_transition_to; parsing and error text unchanged.
pr.title: Replace order status String with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Public API break: Order::status field type changes from String to OrderStatus (requested, but breaks external callers at compile time). Touches every status comparison in billing, shipping, order and report. Observable behaviour verified identical to base by characterization tests passing before and after; reviewer confirmed the same. Reviewer agreed with high.
